changelog: Updated [Role] to emphasise generous candidacy while delegating risk management to ranking and to remind not to rewrite the source text (clarifies behaviour without adding new forbidden positions).

Rewrote [Never Segment] to remove repetition of the frozen output-format constraints (the punctuation/start/end/spacing/minimum rules are now only in [Output Rules]) and to tighten the definition of truly forbidden splits (only positions impossible at any budget).

Replaced and extended examples in both example sections to show frequent placement-failure patterns (polarity before negation, verb sense before postverbal obliques, modifier-head attachments, pronoun antecedent resolution, short temporal/prepositional fragments) with correct segmentation choices so the model learns safe placements by example rather than extra hard rules.
Removed example redundancy and kept the total number of examples within limits while making the examples demonstrate the critic's dominant error modes.
